title.translate: Keep the Meaning With the Words

description.translate: Twelve sheets of paper will restore the refuge's reference shelves. Copy the cautions as carefully as the promises. A fragment can mislead when the warning beside it is forgotten. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

title.translate: Keep the Meaning With the Words

description.translate: The blade must first be recovered from the Hovering Inferno. Its later awakening belongs to the established work that follows, not to a shortcut hidden in these repairs. Your care for the people along this road already matters.
